description: This file declares the Controller class within the rialto::servermanager::ipc namespace, which implements the IController interface. It manages client connections and configurations for session server applications, referencing external classes like Client and ISessionServerAppManager.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Implements the IController interface to manage session server clients, including creation, removal, configuration, and logging levels.

methods.name: Controller
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Controller with a reference to ISessionServerAppManager.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client connection for a given server ID and management socket.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes the client associated with the specified server ID.

methods.name: performSetConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the session server with specified parameters such as initial state, socket name, display name, resource capabilities, and permissions.

methods.name: performPing
methods.description: Performs a ping operation to check server responsiveness.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for the service.
